description: The manifest carries labels for the tags "kampvuur" (nl, en, de) and "avond" (nl, en), and one for "winter", a tag no song uses, which is allowed. The tag "demo" has no label and is shown as its id. The view is unchanged: it carries no labels (PF-41).

format_1_1.note: An app before packages reads the view only and shows the tags as their ids.
